title: AMZN Q3 deep dive: cloud surge and AI investments drive mixed market reception
summary: Cloud computing and online retail behemoth Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 12.1% year on year to $201.9 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $243.5 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.89 per share was 3.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
